_meta.role: Robotics Automation Engineer – AR Glass Testing

summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built and ran robotic automation on a physical Universal Robots UR5e using ROS 2, MoveIt and Python, with forward kinematics and coordinate-frame transforms derived by hand. Delivered computer vision pipelines (OpenCV, YOLO visual servoing), Python automation and data acquisition tools, and sensor integration over UART, USB and Bluetooth on Linux.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 IMU accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Built ball detection by training a YOLOv3 model from scratch on webcam video, then used color masks on the detections to generate and transmit motor commands for closed-loop visual servoing of the competition robot.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical Universal Robots UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline linked by a unified WebSocket fabric (TCP/IP): Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO machine vision for visual servoing (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping; resolved 11 integration failures.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture; deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service on Linux with static IP networking.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies, parent-child transform chains, and SE(3) poses in real time.
